Hoarding limit on photo · 2. Plan and elevation · 3. Melamine layout · 4. Suggested Build Sequence · 5. Site checks · 6. Materials form 1. Hoarding limit on the photo The red outline is the hoarding limit on the floor; the crossed box is the entry. The entry starts 1.2 m from the left end of the front. Test job for v1.1 rule 6 (sheets by height band): Bikini on the Beach at 2.4 m. Not a real job.
2. Plan and elevation All sizes in mm. The dashed red line is the lease line (the shopfront): nothing is fixed to it.

3. Melamine layout and cutting plan Each panel is numbered by the sheet it is cut from. Full sheets S1 to S7 go in whole; the cut pieces sit at the corners. S8 gives the 400 strip for the front right.

4. Suggested Build Sequence Build left to right as seen from the mall: left return, front, right return. 1 Check the truck. Before leaving, check the truck against the materials form to make sure all the material was loaded, including the 2 spare sheets. 2 Arrive and secure the area. Sign in with centre management. Set up barrier tape and the bollard around the work zone. Lay the dust suppression. 3 Set out the hoarding limit. Mark both ends of the lease line and measure 1200 out from each. Snap the 8000 front line parallel to the shopfront. 4 Mark the entry. Measure 1200 from the left end of the front line and mark a 1600 opening (1200 to 2800). 5 Stand the Titan uprights. 10 uprights, each one at a joint between two sheets (never in the middle of a sheet), including one each side of the entry, 4 counterweights on each (weight matrix for 2.4 m). They are marked on the melamine layout. Plus 1 spare upright (10%), not placed on the layout, with its 4 counterweights. 44 counterweights are sent (11 x 4). 6 Frame the walls. Fix the 70 x 45 MGP 10 studs (2.4 m) so every melamine joint lands on a stud. Frame the entry with 2 x 2.4 m and 4 x 2.3 m door studs and a head at 2400. 7 Fix the 2400 sheets. Left return S1; front left S2; front right S3, S4, S5, S6, S8 (400, at the corner); right return S7. 8 Hang the doors. Two 2340 leaves on 4 hinges, metal plates and deadbolt. Check they close and lock. 9 Finish. White tape on every vertical joint, black skirting tape along the base, screw covers, anti-tampers, 6 warning stickers, paint touch-ups. 10 Hand over. Clean up, remove the barrier, photograph each side, complete the installation certificate and sign INST CHK. 5. Site checks Confirm before fixing anything; update the drawings if any differ. [ ] The front measures 8000. [ ] The ceiling is above 2400 along the whole run. [ ] The entry starts 1200 from the left end of the front. [ ] The 1200 returns leave the walkway centre management requires. [ ] Nothing is fixed to the shopfront or floor; the Titan counterweights hold the hoarding. 6. Materials form follows on the next page.
